task.success: all six feet past far edge and up_z >= .8 continuously for .1s; no hard lateral corridor gate
task.objective: stable physical obstacle crossing; path deviation remains a soft cost and separately reported metric

policy.selection: Same normalized Gaussian initial log_std=-1; expected joint correction squared norm per leg matches parent18D at zero policy mean.

action_hold.reward: discounted sum of the unchanged shaped micro rewards; stop at first terminal
action_hold.nominal_budget_caveat: Early terminal can shorten a hold; actual physics time is recorded.
action_hold.neural_input_mode: four causal consecutive10ms frames, not four copies ofcurrentframe

training_phase_cycle.rule: Initial common tripod phase visits each of eight equal-width bins cyclically; uniform-within-bin draw from original CPG random phase. Rank r and r+4 start four bins apart. Evaluation reset unchanged.
training_phase_cycle.scope: Episode starts, not equal decision budget per phase. Changes initial-phase placement relative to antithetic ranks as well as episode-phase coverage.

training_height_jitter.distribution: Independent uniform around the rank-assigned nominal height at every training reset

observation_history.actor: Adult processes4frames withone neural .5-gate step each;MLP concatenates all4frames;one action per40ms

physical_interface: One signed bundled multijoint correction vector per leg; normalize each vector to joint L2 length.15*sqrt(3)rad and mirror individual right coordinates; no phase mask.

neural_ports.note: CV ascending annotations are not exclusively leg proprioception. Changed projection width also changes capacity/initialization scale; MLP rematched.
